primary.poolable_reason: THE NUMERATORS AND THE DENOMINATORS ON THIS PAGE COME FROM DIFFERENT OUTCOMES, ON ALL THREE TRIALS. Each row carried the primary composite's participant denominators -- 3,889 and 3,865; 2,654 and 2,641; 5,470 and 5,469, all exactly right -- against event counts of 8 and 5, 6 and 18, and 18 and 18. Those counts are NOT the composite's. They are ALL-CAUSE MORTALITY, a SECONDARY outcome on every one of the three: CHAMPION-PCI's 'Individual Incidence of All-cause Mortality' is 8 against 5, CHAMPION-PLATFORM's 'Incidence of All-cause Mortality' is 6 against 18, and CHAMPION-PHOENIX's 18 against 18 is the DEATH row of its stent-thrombosis/death/MI breakdown. THE REGISTRY'S OWN PRIMARY-COMPOSITE COUNTS ARE 290 AND 276, 185 AND 210, AND 257 AND 322 -- between one and two ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE larger than what the page used. A mortality numerator over a composite denominator is not a small error in a rate; it is a quantity that corresponds to nothing. AND THE CORRECTION REVERSES THE CONCLUSION, WHICH IS WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN A TIDINESS COMPLAINT. Pooling the registry's own primary counts by DerSimonian-Laird gives OR 0.8955 (0.7526 to 1.0656), I-squared 64 per cent -- AN INTERVAL THAT CROSSES NO EFFECT. The card published OR 0.81 (0.71 to 0.91), which EXCLUDES it. The page reported a significant benefit where the trials' own primary outcomes do not establish one. SEPARATELY AND SUFFICIENT ON ITS OWN: THE COMPOSITES ARE NOT THE SAME. CHAMPION-PHOENIX's registered primary is 'The Composite Incidence of All-cause Mortality, Myocardial Infarction (MI), Ischemia-driven Revascularization (IDR) AND STENT THROMBOSIS (ST)' -- four components. CHAMPION-PCI's and CHAMPION-PLATFORM's are mortality, MI and IDR: three. One whole component is present in one trial and absent from the other two, so even with correct counts these three would not share one estimand.

pooled.withdrawn_note: WHAT IS CONFIRMED, STATED AS PROMINENTLY AS WHAT IS WRONG. (1) THE TRIALS ARE THE RIGHT TRIALS AND THE IDENTITIES ARE CORRECT: NCT00305162, NCT00385138 and NCT01156571 are CHAMPION-PCI, CHAMPION-PLATFORM and CHAMPION-PHOENIX. (2) EVERY ARM SIZE IS EXACTLY RIGHT. All six denominators match the registry's primary-outcome record to the participant. That is what makes the defect so hard to see: five of the six numbers in each 2x2 are correct. (3) THE ARM ROLES AND LABELS ARE CORRECT on all three -- cangrelor against clopidogrel, matching each registration's own arm titles. WHAT THIS WITHDRAWAL DOES NOT ESTABLISH: NOT that cangrelor is ineffective. CHAMPION-PHOENIX's own primary result, 257 of 5,470 against 322 of 5,469, is OR 0.7880 (0.6659 to 0.9326) and favours cangrelor. CHAMPION-PLATFORM's is 0.8674 (0.7063 to 1.0652) and CHAMPION-PCI's is 1.0478 (0.8830 to 1.2434). All three are on this page. The trials disagree with each other, and a synthesis that reports them as agreeing significantly is the thing being withdrawn. THE REPLACEMENT QUESTION IS IDENTIFIED AND DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN. Pooling the correct primary counts is arithmetic, not a new question -- but it still requires choosing whether a four-component composite may be averaged with two three-component ones, and that is an estimand decision whose answer is already visible above. The corrected pool is shown ONLY to demonstrate that the defect changes the conclusion, which cannot be shown without computing it. PARKED.

what_the_registry_counts_give_instead.note: DerSimonian-Laird over the three registry primary counts. Shown ONLY to establish that the defect changes the conclusion: this interval crosses no effect and the published one does not.

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.a_the_withdrawn_value_matches_a_publishe: THE 0.81 THIS PAGE RECORDS AS THE WITHDRAWN CARD'S FIGURE IS ALSO THE PUBLISHED ONE. Steg et al., Lancet 2013 (PMID 24011551) -- a PRESPECIFIED pooled analysis of PATIENT-LEVEL data from all three CHAMPION trials, 24,910 patients -- reports the primary composite at OR 0.81 (0.71 to 0.91). The withdrawal note on this outcome records that the card published OR 0.81 (0.71 to 0.91). THE SAME VALUE AND THE SAME INTERVAL.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.b_what_that_changes_and_what_it_does_not: IT DOES NOT UNDO THE WITHDRAWAL. This object establishes that the card's own stored numerators were ALL-CAUSE MORTALITY counts set against the primary composite's denominators, on all three trials, and that is a real data defect. WHAT IT CHANGES IS THE READING: the card's headline value appears to have been RIGHT while the counts beneath it could not produce it. A correct number standing on the wrong arithmetic is a PROVENANCE failure, not an accuracy one, and the withdrawal note currently reads as though the benefit itself were unsupported.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.c_what_this_object_can_and_cannot_pool: From published aggregates this review can pool only CHAMPION-PCI and CHAMPION-PLATFORM on the three-component composite, because CHAMPION PHOENIX (NCT01156571) REGISTERS A FOUR-COMPONENT composite adding stent thrombosis -- its counts are recorded here, 257/5470 against 322/5469, so the exclusion is checkable. Steg et al. had patient-level data and could rebuild the three-component quantity for PHOENIX; THAT IS NOT RECOVERABLE FROM AGGREGATES. The two-trial pool is 0.965 (0.813 to 1.14) and CROSSES NO DIFFERENCE where theirs does not.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.d_which_a_reader_should_prefer_and_what_: PREFER THE PUBLISHED ANALYSIS. Three trials at patient level, prespecified, beats two trials of aggregate counts. UNRESOLVED, AND NOT DECIDED HERE: whether this outcome's withdrawal note should be restated now that the withdrawn figure is corroborated by the literature. That is a content decision about a published number and belongs to the author.

pooled_hartung_knapp.why_it_is_shown: Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.5 recommends Hartung-Knapp where k is small. Shown ALONGSIDE the unadjusted interval, not instead of it. A FLOOR OF 1 is applied to the variance-inflation factor so the adjustment can never NARROW the interval below the unadjusted one.

heterogeneity.DIRECTION_TEST: NOT APPLICABLE -- I-squared is 47.8%, below the threshold at which the direction test is informative. The trials are consistent with a common effect and no heterogeneity caution is warranted. Applying one here would manufacture doubt the data do not support, which is the mirror failure of ignoring heterogeneity that matters.
heterogeneity.how_to_read_this_at_low_k: At k=2 or k=3 these statistics are weak evidence about consistency in EITHER direction. A low value means the estimates are CONSISTENT WITH a common effect, not that one is demonstrated.

corrected_composite_3component.outcome: all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, or ischaemia-driven revascularisation
corrected_composite_3component.WHY_THIS_REPLACES_A_WITHDRAWAL: THE WITHDRAWAL WAS FOR A DATA-INTEGRITY ERROR, NOT AN ENDPOINT MISMATCH. The page had carried numerators from one outcome against denominators from another. THE ENDPOINTS AGREE: CHAMPION PCI and CHAMPION PLATFORM register the IDENTICAL primary, verbatim -- "Incidence of All-cause Mortality, Myocardial Infarction (MI), and Ischemia-driven Revascularization (IDR)". Counts and denominators are re-read from each registrations posted results on 2026-08-18 and now come from the same outcome.
corrected_composite_3component.the_third_trial_EXCLUDED_and_why: CHAMPION PHOENIX (NCT01156571) registers a FOUR-component composite -- it adds STENT THROMBOSIS to the same three. That is a different quantity, and its counts are recorded here so the exclusion is checkable: 257/5470 against 322/5469. Pooling it would repeat the error this page was withdrawn for.
corrected_composite_3component.recoverable_by_correcting_the_data_not_b: A CATEGORY THE PROPORTIONALITY SWEEP CANNOT SEE. That sweep never reads our verdicts -- the design choice that keeps it honest -- so it flagged this topic on shared outcome concepts and could not tell that the withdrawal was about mis-transcribed data. THE SWEEP IS NOT EXHAUSTIVE and this class will always be invisible to it.
corrected_composite_3component.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that either trial is free of bias; no risk-of-bias assessment is recorded. NOT a result including CHAMPION PHOENIX, whose composite differs. NOT that the original withdrawal was wrong -- the data on the page WAS mismatched and that withdrawal was correct; what was missing was the corrected pool.

POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.a_a_published_patient_level_analysis_dis: THIS ESTIMATE IS COMPATIBLE WITH NO BENEFIT AND A LARGER PRESPECIFIED ANALYSIS IS NOT. This pool: 0.9646 (0.8132 to 1.1442) on 2 trials, from published aggregate counts. Steg et al., Lancet 2013 (PMID 24011551), a PRESPECIFIED POOLED ANALYSIS OF PATIENT-LEVEL DATA from ALL THREE CHAMPION trials, 24,910 patients: the same three-component composite -- all-cause death, myocardial infarction or ischaemia-driven revascularisation at 48 hours -- returns ODDS RATIO 0.81 (0.71 to 0.92). THEIR INTERVAL EXCLUDES NO DIFFERENCE AND THIS ONE DOES NOT.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.b_why_the_two_differ_and_it_is_not_an_er: THE THIRD TRIAL. CHAMPION PHOENIX (NCT01156571) is on this object and is EXCLUDED from this pool with a stated reason: it registers a FOUR-component composite, adding stent thrombosis to the same three, and its counts are recorded here so the exclusion is checkable -- 257/5470 against 322/5469. Steg et al. had PATIENT-LEVEL DATA and could rebuild the three-component composite for PHOENIX; FROM PUBLISHED AGGREGATES THAT CANNOT BE DONE. The difference is one of DATA ACCESS, not of care.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.c_which_estimate_a_reader_should_prefer: THEIRS. A prespecified patient-level analysis of three trials is stronger evidence than an aggregate-data pool of two, and it includes a trial this object cannot include honestly. This pool is reported because it is what the registered aggregate data support; IT IS NOT OFFERED AS THE BETTER ANSWER.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_20.d_what_remains_unresolved: Whether this object should carry a three-component pool at all, given that the quantity is recoverable only with patient-level data that this review does not have. That is a content decision and has not been made.

r_output.what_it_is: The random-effects fit of THIS BLOCK'S OWN per-trial estimates, quoted as the software printed it.
r_output.scale_note: READ FROM THE MEASURE, NOT ASSUMED. This measure is RR, so the fit is on the log scale. The script log-transformed unconditionally until 2026-08-21, which is right for RR/OR/HR/IRR and WRONG for a mean difference -- on this corpus it would have printed 'unadjusted 1685.7331 (162.3105 to 17507.7801)' for a 7.43-point KCCQ difference, and limb 4 stores that output VERBATIM.
r_output.interval_method: REML with the unadjusted Wald interval, and the same fit under Hartung-Knapp beside it. THE HOUSE INTERVAL FLOORS THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR AT max(1, SE_knha / SE_unadjusted); metafor's raw unfloored value is printed separately and flagged where it is narrower than the unadjusted interval.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: Does cangrelor reduce ischaemic events at PCI? The three CHAMPION trials answer versions of this, and the numbers this page used were not the ones they answered it with..

It pools 3 randomised trials, against clopidogrel.

The outcome pooled is Death, myocardial infarction or ischaemia-driven revascularisation at 48 hours -- and stent thrombosis in one of the three trials.

WHAT THIS PARAGRAPH DOES NOT CONTAIN, AND WHY. Why the question is open, what this review adds to what was already known, and what the pooled effect means clinically are JUDGEMENTS, not fields, and no field on this object can back them. They are owed and they are not written here; assembling them from the numbers above would be inventing a rationale to fit a result. Everything above is derived from stored fields and nothing in it is authored.

THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES NO DIFFERENCE AND OURS DOES NOT -- opposite conclusions, not a rounding gap. The k difference is stated first because a dropped trial is the likeliest cause.

published_comparison.THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2: A MATERIAL DISAGREEMENT, AND IT IS NOT A CLASS-76 INSTANCE. Class 76 is about the published work choosing a better-defined target; here it chose the SAME target and got a different answer with MORE data. Steg 2013 pooled all three CHAMPION trials at patient level to OR 0.81 (0.71 to 0.92) on the triple composite; this object pools TWO to 0.9646 (0.8132 to 1.1442). One interval excludes no difference and the other does not. SEPARATELY, THIS OBJECT'S DECLARED PRIMARY OUTCOME CARRIES NO POOLED ESTIMATE AT ALL despite k = 3. Which trial is absent from the three-component pool, and whether 0.9646 should stand, is a content decision and is not made here.
published_comparison.CORRECTION_2026_08_20: AN EARLIER SENTENCE IN THIS BLOCK SAID 'a dropped trial is the likeliest cause' AND PUT THE k DIFFERENCE FIRST. THE TRIAL WAS NOT DROPPED. NCT01156571 is on this object and is excluded from the corrected composite for a stated, checkable reason -- it registers a four-component composite. Calling it a drop implied a carelessness the object's own record refutes, and the correction is recorded here rather than made silently.
